subject: Palisade status: students trained on 5 tasks, MATH is the outlier
body:
Hi Alina, Dmitri,

Palisade status. We beat the April 17 milestone: mistral-7b students trained on five tasks, not four. Deltas over the no-augmentation baseline: ARC +6.8, GSM8K +5.9, CSQA +4.4, TabMWP +7.1, ANLI +3.2 (accuracy points, three seeds each). The backward-reasoning component is doing real work - ablating it costs roughly half the gain on GSM8K, consistent with the paper's story.

The outlier is MATH, as Alina predicted from the pilot: teacher backward-questions there are often ill-posed (you can't always invert a competition problem cleanly), and the filtered second pass only recovered part of the quality. Current MATH delta is +1.1, within seed noise.

Recommendation for the go/no-go: ship the student refresh on the five strong tasks, hold MATH out rather than diluting the average, and note it as a known limitation. Freya agrees.

Quentin
